title: China delivers a one-two punch to America’s AI dominance
slides: China just released two AI models that beat GPT-4.
One focuses on reasoning, the other on image generation.
Both were trained with far less computing power than US rivals.
Your next AI upgrade may come from outside Silicon Valley.
Test DeepSeek-R1 and Qwen-VL before locking your stack.
thread_text:
1. Your next AI isn't American.

China just dropped two models that outperform GPT-4 on reasoning and image generation. Both used far less compute than US counterparts.

2. One model thinks harder.

DeepSeek-R1 focuses on chain-of-thought reasoning, beating GPT-4 on math and coding benchmarks with 90% less compute.

3. The other sees sharper.

Qwen-VL generates images from text with higher fidelity than GPT-4V, yet trained on a fraction of the energy bill.

4. Compute isn't the moat anymore.

If a constrained setup can match or beat billion-dollar clusters, the hardware advantage collapses. Efficiency now wins.

5. Should you lock your stack today?

Test both models this week on a real task before deciding your infrastructure — otherwise you might commit to yesterday's leader.
